run_spot_3d_mapping: run the Spot robot 3D mapping example to build a voxel map and save point cloud data
create_voxel_map: create a SparseVoxelMap with a given resolution and local radius for 3D spatial aggregation
build_navigation_space: build a SparseVoxelMapNavigationSpace using a voxel map, robot kinematics model, and step size
create_semantic_sensor: create an OvmmPerception semantic sensor with a config and detic module for scene labeling
control_spot_robot: control a Spot robot using SpotClient to start, move with linear and angular velocities, and stop
